{{Quote|It couldn'ta been underground, could it?|The man speculates on the source of the explosion|<ref name="TNR" />}}
In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> a '''man''' was present in the [[Crystal Jewel]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], when a nearby [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|explosion]] rocked the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall. The casino sustained damage, and, believing it signified an attack on the capital, many casino patrons fled the premises. Once outside, the man conversed with a [[Unidentified Gotal patron|Gotal]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] over the possible location of the explosion; in actuality, the nearby [[Senate Hall]]. The man appeared familiar to the Human, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The patron appeared in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', a [[1996]] novel written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
